applies_to: observational comparisons; not validated causal outcomes
all_cities: Surface temperature is not felt or air temperature.
No dated planting record is not proof of no planting.
Post-window plantings in treated cells can contribute to later contrasts.
Cross-sensor sensitivity is not independent confirmation.
Some static matching features may postdate planting; source-year columns must be considered before causal interpretation.

nyc: Dated inventory begins in 2015; earlier cohorts can mature unseen in both groups.
The 2008-2011 same-sensor pre-cohort fake-date check found a nonzero contrast.
Matching on noisy pre-outcomes can select regression to the mean.
dc: Current tree-space records overwrite some past removals; survivorship/history bias is possible.
Thin pre-period and poor matching overlap limit identification.
sea: Excluded January-1 dates represent real trees with unknown planting dates; some controls may have been planted.
A negative association does not establish a causal effect.
sf: Standing-tree records omit historical removals; survivorship bias is possible.
Some dated records lack coordinates; fog limits summer observations.
